propositions: Three separate code paths (normal compaction, fsck rebuild, crash recovery) independently re-derive identical decisions for candidate listing, snapshot detection, envelope building, and retire-rename logic, creating maintenance and correctness risks.
The snapshot envelope structure and source_event_uuids/compacted_at keys are duplicated across compact_txn and compact_rebuild, with compact_txn admitting it mirrors compact_rebuild.

The retired file rename-back rule and its data-loss guard appear three times with inconsistent implementations (compact_txn, compact_recovery, and rollback paths), creating divergence in crash semantics.
A stray non-JSON file in a ticket directory can be incorrectly included in source_event_uuids and retired by the rebuild due to inconsistent file-type filtering across the three paths.

Consolidating these derivations into a shared compact_plan module with stable Candidate, snapshot detection, envelope building, and retire-restore functions will eliminate duplication while preserving existing crash semantics and repair idempotence.
